findings.summary: PR-32 [I] is defensible but slightly generous: the golden file pins only BASE_INSTRUCTIONS (tool schemas and other prompt text are covered only indirectly by the replays), and nothing requires the suite by path; the row's own text says both tests run in every pytest run and so in the full gate, which is true. Suggest [Pa] only if the owner wants the old 'by path' gap kept visible; no change required.
